composition_note: Examples remain non-prescriptive activity/view labels for existing readers. O-I#268 with the owner's 18 September 2026 correction: CF5 contains six forms of engagement, not necessarily six local installs. CF7 5/0 is hosted Library/Expression learning. Selected/effective/installed, visitor versus host, experience surface, source sync and material connection remain separate. INSTALLATION-VARIANTS.md is the current source. Neither this source nor a CF string proves runtime support.

installation_composition.source_amendment: 2026-09-18: retain this existing planning key and frame identities; CF7 is hosted engagement, not a visitor installation. This is not an executable installer schema or a reinterpretation of historical receipts.

containing_frame.meaning: The material nesting condition for every engagement form, not a maximal installed-package tier; host and visitor material are separately observed.

forms.required_observation: Desktop is independently addable/removable; selected underlying useful work and source survive.
forms.not_implied: CF1 is not CF3; a chosen writing-only backing does not promise agent features.

forms.required_observation: Existing realised agent tool uses durable relevant ground and explicit bounds without hidden AIKit, Factory or QL installation.
Relevant source and practice reach an actual ordinary task through the person's selected tool; desktop optional.
Actual coordinated development coexists with ordinary sessions; Factory presence does not commission every conversation.

forms.composition: Central + minimal Workcell client/connectivity to a separately realised world
forms.required_observation: An authorised remote activity/service is reachable with private source/access boundaries; remote software is not reported as local installation.

forms.composition: Hosted O:I Web Library + accepted Expression renderer + published source-bound corpus/edition
forms.native_products_scope: visitor-local required O:I packages, not the host's software composition
forms.default_collection: owner-curated published Epi-Logos corpus in the existing shared Library, not another catalogue or the limit of O:I Web
forms.required_observation: Clean browser with no local O:I installation: Library → real source-bound subject → live Expression → declared relation/source → same reading position; deep-link reload and truthful optional-service/renderer loss. Published corpus/source/projection and visitor state retain distinct identities.
forms.implementation_followup: O-I#268 removes mandatory learner-install assumptions in native catalogue/setup/help through reviewed compatibility changes; #375/#366 and QL-MEF#201 supply the same hosted/app corpus consumer. No runtime migration is claimed by this planning record.

installation_composition.all_products_with_or_without_desktop: Supported inside CF5; no eighth frame and no CF5-by-package-count derivation.
installation_composition.variant_rule: A story/form link requests applicability review and concrete episode binding, not every action in that family being supported by the minimum composition. Excluded local products must actually be absent in installed-minimum proof. CF7 tests a clean visitor browser, not a fictitious learner package install/uninstall; host administration and optional personal/shared participation are separate.
installation_composition.readiness: specified; native composition implementation and actual hosted/installed proof are separate

sandbox_proving.host_role: Omarchy development/reference host with bounded disposable test worlds
sandbox_proving.mac_role: installed acceptance/ordinary-use world; not a disposable test target
sandbox_proving.provider_readiness: verify actual current native offers, isolation and lifecycle in C1; this source pass did not inspect the host
sandbox_proving.foundation_policy: Consume the existing Day/NOW foundation return before broad Factory-dependent fan-out; continue authorised independent work and foundation-building tests. Do not add a premature H gate.
episode_binding: existing UX story and full parent obligations
provider/sandbox/image generation and actual OS/hardware scope
sandbox_proving.parallelism: Disjoint writable worlds and supported guest desktops may run concurrently within measured capacity; shared host services, data/indexes, Git targets, installations and desktop focus are serialized.
sandbox_proving.fixture_rule: Preserve original UX/source expectation and failed episode; source-backed fixture correction and native repair require independent replay. No expected-answer coaching, weakened assertions or silent scope reduction.
sandbox_proving.evidence_scope: Real automation can supply D/C/P and applicable M at its observed scope; guest isolation is not independent physical hardware, macOS packaging or human H/EX.
